data.title: Use the physical board microphone as the voice input instead of the Mac mic

evidence: Board: it already runs Leo's new firmware, so I didn't flash anything. ... Voice station: running with `--mic board`.

data.answer: Yes. The board already runs Leo's new office_station firmware with board-microphone push-to-talk (Leo commit 4dd6741 'board-microphone push-to-talk into the office agent'), so nothing was flashed. voice_station.py defaults to --mic board.

evidence: Board: it already runs Leo's new firmware, so I didn't flash anything. The mic, button, screen, speaker, CO₂, temperature and distance sensors all respond.
